pieces.title: Harvest of the Grinning Dark
pieces.description: A giant glowing jack-o'-lantern with a menacing carved grin looms over smaller grinning pumpkins in a murky field of tangled, thorny vines at night.

pieces.title: Staircase Within the Iris
pieces.description: A macro close-up of a dark human eye whose iris contains a candlelit spiral staircase and a lone cloaked figure facing a swirling tunnel.

pieces.title: Neon Mushroom Pond Reverie
pieces.description: A pointy-eared fairy girl in a glowing mushroom cap hat eats an ice cream cone in a neon pond with glowing jars, lily pads, and giant eyes above.

pieces.title: Ember Queen of Ash
pieces.description: A red-haired woman in black armor veined with glowing lava stands amid swirling flames, holding a ball of fire in her outstretched hand.

pieces.title: Stormborn Silver Sentinel

pieces.title: Headlines Under the Skin
